beats.text: Six quiet signs of genuine self-respect.
One. You can say no without delivering a whole paragraph of apologies and excuses.
Two. You stop chasing people who have made it clear they won't choose you.
Three. You keep your own standards even when absolutely no one is watching.
Four. You walk away from disrespect — calmly, without needing a dramatic scene.
Five. You stop shrinking yourself just to keep other people comfortable.
Six. You can rest without guilt. You don't have to earn the right to exist.
Self-respect isn't loud or arrogant. It's just the quiet refusal to abandon yourself.
